Убрать фон (сделать прозрачным). Фон мод: Remove the background (make it transparent). The background is modeled from the image border as a few color clusters and compared by perception (Lab); the tolerance is found from the spread of the border colors, the fill follows a smooth gradient and noise of the background by itself (follow) and the sharp edge of the subject stops it. The antialiased rim at the edge is removed (defringe). By default what is connected to the edge is erased; background enclosed by the subject (between an arm and the body) is erased when it covers at least 3% of the picture (enclosed), so eye whites stay. Pixel art with an exact background color is processed exactly. An explicit tolerance switches to the old mode without gradient following (until follow is set); tolerance 0 means the exact color only.

limit:int=90 (при follow: насколько фон: limit:int=90 (with follow: how far the background may drift from the background model)

Вырезать предмет со сложного фона без не: Cut a subject out of a complex background without a neural network: the background colors are taken from the border (up to clusters of them; a color that covers only a small part of the border does not count as background, so a subject at the edge is not eaten). Mode distance (default): each pixel gets its Lab distance to the background colors, the map is smoothed, the threshold is found by itself (or set threshold), and the background is what is below the threshold and connected to the picture edge; the fill follows a smooth gradient and noise by itself (follow), and the background model is refined from the background found so far until the result stops changing, so running it again changes nothing. The antialiased rim is removed (defringe), background enclosed by the subject is erased when it covers at least 3% of the picture (enclosed). Mode flood: a fill from the edges that does not cross the subject boundaries (edgeStop). The largest area is kept (keepLargest). For a plain background removeBackground is simpler.
mode:string=distance (distance: расстоян: mode:string=distance (distance: Lab distance to the background colors with an automatic threshold, steadier on photos; flood: a fill with a boundary barrier)

smooth:int=0 (для distance: радиус сглаж: smooth:int=0 (for distance: the smoothing radius of the distance map; needed only for a very noisy background)
Автоуровни: растягивает диапазон яркости: Auto levels: stretches the brightness range to 0..255. Dull, washed-out pictures get more contrast. cutoff: the percent of the darkest and the lightest pixels to ignore (1-2 for a photo with stray highlights).
Медианный фильтр (как MedianFilter в Pil: Median filter (like Pillow's MedianFilter): every channel of a pixel becomes the median of the (2r+1)×(2r+1) window. Removes JPEG noise and photo grain but keeps sharp edges. Do it before downscaling a photo.
Нерезкая маска (как UnsharpMask в Pillow: Unsharp mask (like Pillow's UnsharpMask): adds amount × (the picture minus its blur of the given radius). Brings back sharpness after a downscale so thin lines survive quantizing.
Линии границ по яркости (оператор Собеля: Edge lines by brightness (the Sobel operator, like Pillow's FIND_EDGES). threshold 0..255: the smaller, the more lines; thin gives one-pixel lines; onlyLines draws only the lines on a transparent background (a line drawing of the photo).

Для фото и картинок из сети: убрать шум: For photos and pictures from the web: remove noise with a median filter, cut the subject out of the background (a non-uniform one too), liven up the colors, downscale to 64 px keeping edges, bring the sharpness back, reduce to 16 perceptual colors, clean up junk and edges, add a colored outline. The result is checked.
Любая картинка в спрайт до 128 px с боль: Any picture to a sprite up to 128 px with plenty of detail: remove noise, cut the subject out of the background, liven up the colors, downscale keeping edges, bring the sharpness back, 24 perceptual colors, clean up junk, a colored outline. The result is checked.
